security.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: See and clean up what your AI coding agents load
bundle.longDescription: Agentry shows every skill, plugin, memory file, MCP server, subagent, command and hook that Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI and other AI coding agents load, with its disk size and context-token cost, and removes them safely.
